hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.cls|*.trigger|*.js|*.html|*.css|*.json|*.xml) npx prettier --write "$f" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac

F=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$F" in *dev-path/*/spec.md) P="Intent|Outcomes|Out of scope|Open questions|Evidence|Current state|Design|Outcome checks|dev-path feedback";; *dev-path/*/slices/*.md) P="What to build|Acceptance criteria|Deviations|Critique findings";; *) exit 0;; esac; grep -n '^## ' "$F" | grep -Ev "^[0-9]+:## ($P)$" && echo "dev-path: $F carries a heading outside the schema"; exit 0
